question: Does the Mondoze 2 GB Linux VPS (MY) V2 have quarterly, semi-annual or biennial terms, and at what price?
why: the cart's billing-cycle dropdown renders no options through any route tried (raw fetch redirects to the store page; cfbr and browserless render an empty configure shell; jina renders the order summary with only the annually term selected), so only the monthly (USD 8.33, store page) and annual (USD 99.95, cart summary) terms are evidenced
